item.title: Erysipelas-Diamond Skin Disease -
item.description: Erysipelas Erysipelas, also called diamond skin disease, is a bacterial disease that can be fatal. The bacterium is found in the environment and can survive in soil or waste for 6 months. It is carried by birds and rodents.
